meta.title: Sri Lanka Destinations & Regions
meta.description: Explore Sri Lanka’s regions on a stylised island map — the Cultural Triangle, tea country, southern and eastern coasts and wildlife parks — with the best months to visit each, privately guided by licensed guide Dinesh Jayasuriya.

hero.title: Diverse Terrains, Ancient Echoes & Untamed Horizons
hero.intro: Explore Sri Lanka’s 6 distinct biogeographic provinces—from sun-drenched Jaffna palmyra plains to mist-shrouded cloud forests of the Central Massif and golden southern shores. Every destination handpicked and privately guided by accredited National Guide Dinesh Jayasuriya.

season.title: The Dual-Monsoon Seasonal Matrix
season.intro: Sri Lanka is blessed by two alternating weather systems (Yala & Maha monsoons). While one coastline experiences nourishing rains, the opposite coast enjoys crystal skies and calm turquoise seas.
season.caption: Best months to visit each region of Sri Lanka, from January to December

insight.quote: “Because Sri Lanka benefits from two alternating weather systems, there is ALWAYS a sun-drenched coast and glorious dry terrain in any month of the year. You never need to compromise on climate.”
